identity.title: ALMA Observation of 158 μm [C II] Line and Dust Continuum of a z = 7 Normally Star-forming Galaxy in the Epoch of Reionization

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present ALMA observations of the [CII] line and far-infrared (FIR) continuum of a normally star-forming galaxy in the reionization epoch, the $z=6.96$ Ly$\alpha$ emitter (LAE) IOK-1.

evidence.quote: We observed IOK-1 by targeting its [CII] line redshifted to $z=6.96$ measured from Ly$\alpha$ emission
We observed IOK-1 by targeting its [CII] line redshifted to $z=6.96$ measured from Ly$\alpha$ emission

question.value: What are the [CII] line and FIR dust continuum properties (dust mass, IR luminosity, obscured SFR) of a normal z=6.96 LAE, IOK-1, and how does it compare with other galaxy populations?

evidence.quote: Motivated by this, we conducted a [CII] line and FIR continuum observation of such a galaxy with ALMA.
(1.26 mm, 238.76 GHz in the observer’s frame or 157.74 $\mu$m, 1900.54 GHz at rest frame)

evidence.quote: with central frequencies of 223.76, 225.76, 238.76 and 240.76 GHz.
